**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Miss Smith](../persons.html#263)
I enclose a cheque for the amount of the Banks of the Thorne that has gone in this time, and I think has been very much liked.
I have had an offer of [Mrs Sherwood](../persons.html#1869)’s Life from a person who can get at something about her privately so I thought you would not mind my accepting it, as a little beyond a published memoir is such a gain.[^1]
You see the [Packet](../others.html#52) is flourishing and can [pay](../others.html#102) a little more this time

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Carter Smith had evidently offered to contribute a life of Sherwood to the [Biographies of Good Women](../books.html#43); however none appeared in either of the two series.
